checked_declarations.name: uniform_atom_bound
checked_declarations.statement:
(n x : int) :
  0 < n => mu1 (dinter 0 (n-1)) x <= 1%r / n%r.

checked_declarations.name: one_seed_hit_bound
checked_declarations.statement:
(n : int) (candidates : int list) :
  0 < n =>
  mu (dinter 0 (n-1)) (mem candidates)
  <= (size candidates)%r * (1%r / n%r).

checked_declarations.name: two_seed_hit_bound
checked_declarations.statement:
(n : int) (prefixes suffixes : int list) :
  0 < n =>
  mu (dinter 0 (n-1) `*` dinter 0 (n-1))
    (fun (keys : int * int) => keys.`1 \in prefixes \/ keys.`2 \in suffixes)
  <= (size prefixes + size suffixes)%r * (1%r / n%r).

checked_declarations.name: key_blind_game_bound
checked_declarations.statement:
(n : int) (prefixes suffixes : int list) :
  0 < n =>
  phoare [KeyBlind.sample : arg = (prefixes,suffixes,n) ==> res]
    <= ((size prefixes + size suffixes)%r * (1%r / n%r)).

scope: Candidate lists and n are fixed as procedure inputs before uniform independent keys are sampled. No adaptive source transcript or RO coupling is encoded.
